source: Per-company AR extraction (Screener.in PDFs + IR sites) — Claude.ai routine, daily batch of 20

rural.evidence: FY25 commentary highlights strong growth from leisure/tourist destinations (Rajasthan +27% consolidated growth, Goa +29% consolidated growth) but no explicit rural revenue percentage was disclosed in sources found.

china_plus_one.evidence: Reports on Divi's FY25 disclosures indicate the company has pursued diversified raw-material sourcing to reduce China dependence and secured long-term supply agreements/proactive logistics planning amid global supply chain shifts; global innovators seeking scalable, reliable partners are cited as a tailwind, but no explicit AR quote tying a specific revenue/order figure to China+1 was located.

inr_exposure.evidence: Company derives ~88% of FY25 sales revenue from exports (Europe 56.46%, North America 16.18%, Asia 11.35%, RoW 3.99%), implying material foreign-currency exposure, but specific hedging policy language was not located.

rural.evidence: Tier-3+ cities contributed 34% of revenue in FY23 rising toward 39% in FY26 per company disclosures; Delhi-NCR's own share fell to 31% of revenue by end of FY24 as the company expanded into smaller towns. Exact FY24-25 tier-3+ revenue share was not found in sources reviewed.

inr_exposure.evidence: Company has small international operations (Nepal, Bangladesh; Dubai subsidiary incorporated later), but consolidated international revenue as % of total was not disclosed in sources reviewed.

FY25 domestic revenue ~Rs 3,660 cr (up 16.4%), international revenue ~Rs 4,236 cr (up 20.5%, >54% of total sales) split across Emerging Markets (~Rs 1,510 cr), Europe (~Rs 1,474 cr) and Canada (~Rs 1,252 cr). Specific USD-denominated share and hedging policy not found in sources reviewed.

pli_scheme.evidence: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited was approved as a domestic applicant under India's Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme for pharmaceuticals/APIs, which targets reducing India's dependence on China for ~53 critical API/KSM molecules. Revenue contribution from PLI-linked production not disclosed in sources reviewed.

rural.evidence: "Despite subdued demand across urban and rural geographies, the company continued to make steady progress, with robust revenue and underlying volume growth and healthy levels of profitability... remains cautiously optimistic on improved demand conditions as a result of the good monsoon and increased construction activities." No specific rural revenue % disclosed.

crude_exposure.evidence: FY25 raw material cost was INR 60,521 million; gross margin improved ~100bps YoY on benign input prices. "PIDI has multiple sourcing arrangements for critical inputs such as VAM [vinyl acetate monomer, a key petrochemical/crude-derived input], ensuring continuity of supply," with VAM prices noted as spiking temporarily entering FY26. Exact raw-material-as-%-of-revenue/COGS not found.

inr_exposure.evidence: Overseas subsidiaries generated an estimated ~Rs 647 crore in FY25 (roughly 6.5-7.3% of consolidated revenue per third-party estimates), implying modest foreign-currency revenue exposure; formal hedging policy not found in sources reviewed.

rate_sensitive.evidence: "Endurance has a strong financial risk profile evidenced by low leverage and strong debt coverage indicators, with limited dependence on external borrowings," reporting a negative net debt (net cash) position on a consolidated basis in FY2024 per rating agency commentary. No specific floating-rate liability % disclosed.

crude_exposure.evidence: Endurance manufactures aluminium die-casting (incl. alloy wheels), suspension, transmission and braking products; raw material cost volatility, particularly aluminium and steel prices, is cited as a margin risk, but no specific % of revenue/COGS was disclosed in sources reviewed.

inr_exposure.evidence: In FY25, consolidated revenue of ~Rs 11,560.8 cr was split ~75.8% India, ~23.6% Europe (Euro-denominated subsidiaries, grew 15.4% YoY with EBITDA growth of 20.9%), and ~0.6% Maxwell; implying meaningful EUR revenue/cost exposure. Specific hedging policy not found in sources reviewed.

rural.evidence: MD&A commentary (per press coverage of the FY25 report): 'Rural India remains one of Nestle India's most significant growth opportunities, given both the pace of demand expansion and the headroom to deepen its presence'; rural recovery described as shaped by monsoon outcomes, farm income and government support. No specific rural revenue percentage was found.

crude_exposure.evidence: Press summaries of company commentary note 'rising raw material costs and crude-linked packaging expenses are putting pressure on margins', but no quantified crude/raw-material percentage was located.

inr_exposure.evidence: Third-party summary states Nestle India sources 'more than 97 percent of its materials locally', suggesting limited direct import/forex exposure despite global commodity price pass-through; not verified against primary AR text.

china_plus_one.evidence: Royal Enfield FY25 exports rose 29.7% to 100,136 units (domestic 902,757 of 1,002,893 total units, i.e. ~10% export mix); company is reported to be targeting international markets to contribute ~40% of revenue by 2028. No explicit China+1/supply-chain-diversification framing found in available excerpts.

rural.evidence: Third-party press commentary (not confirmed against primary AR text): 'Rural demand was rising and continued to outpace urban sales growth, with rural sales accounting for a third of Royal Enfield's sales.' Company has also been expanding smaller-format 'studio' outlets in rural markets.

pli_scheme.evidence: Eicher Motors is reported as approved under the Champion OEM Incentive component of India's PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components (sales-value-linked scheme for BEVs/advanced automotive tech); incentive disbursement for Eicher expected to begin from FY2026-27 alongside other OEMs.

china_plus_one.evidence: Third-party summary states 'exports are decided by global ABB divisions based on market needs' and are not a primary strategic focus for the India entity; no company-specific China+1 diversification narrative located in available excerpts.

govt_capex.evidence: Analyst/press commentary on ABB India's order momentum: 'ABB India benefits from sustained public capex, particularly in infrastructure, railways and green energy'; demand drivers cited include data-center automation, T&D capex under the National Electricity Plan, and railways/metro electrification, with the Union Budget capex outlay described as a tailwind. No specific % of revenue tied to government capex was disclosed in the excerpts found.

inr_exposure.evidence: Domestic:export revenue split reported as approximately 90:10 in ABB India's 2023 Annual Report; 2024 split not confirmed in available excerpts.

pli_scheme.evidence: No evidence found of ABB India being listed as a PLI scheme beneficiary (electronics components or capital goods PLI tranches).

china_plus_one.evidence: 'Ongoing trade tensions between the U.S. and China are prompting global pharma players to diversify suppliers and invest in regional manufacturing hubs, with policies like the proposed Biosecure Act aimed at reducing dependency on China. Lupin, with its robust India-based manufacturing and CDMO operations, is well placed to support this transition.' API/CDMO business described as reflecting 'strong alignment with global industry trends such as supply chain diversification, CDMO outsourcing, and high-potency APIs', with API business growing 4% YoY in Q3 FY25 -- growth is linked to industry trends generally rather than explicitly attributed to China+1 alone.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Natural hedges and forex derivatives are deployed; treasury operations actively monitor exposures and adopt layered hedging strategies to manage USD-INR, EUR-INR and ZAR-INR fluctuations.
inr_exposure.evidence: FY2025 revenue geography: US 36% (~USD 925 Mn), India 34% (INR 75,773 Mn formulations), developed markets ex-US (Canada, Australia, Europe, others) 13%, other emerging markets (LATAM, South Africa, Philippines, rest) 11%, API business ~5% of global sales.

pli_scheme.evidence: Lupin was approved as a domestic applicant under Group A of India's PLI Scheme for Pharmaceuticals (aimed at boosting domestic manufacturing of critical bulk drugs/KSMs/APIs); scheme runs FY21-FY29 with total outlay of Rs 15,000 crore across all beneficiaries. Company-specific revenue impact percentage not disclosed in excerpts found.

rural.evidence: Country Liquor (economy/mass segment) caters largely to the price-sensitive rural consumer base; the 'regular' segment volumes registered sharp growth of 79.6% after nine quarters of de-growth, per third-party coverage of FY25 results (no rural revenue % disclosed).

crude_exposure.evidence: Key raw materials are molasses/grain (ENA) and glass/packaging, not crude oil; with commissioning of the Sitapur grain-based distillery in FY25, cost linkage shifted more toward grain prices than ENA. No crude-oil-linked input disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: Company exports to 100+ countries but is overwhelmingly domestic-revenue; third-party sources give conflicting export shares (~6.6% of turnover per one equity report vs. 'about a tenth of revenue' per another), so no reliable single figure could be confirmed.

rural.evidence: "Distribution has remained a strength for the organisation, given years of experience running the business, particularly in rural markets" — business built on a field force of 12,000+ medical reps and 7,000+ stockists/depots across India, no rural revenue % disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: International sales (largely US-dollar denominated, led by the US market) contributed roughly 30-32% of revenue in recent periods; no explicit hedging policy disclosure found. Split (India 70% / US 21% / other international 8%) is the most recent breakdown found via third-party sources, dated to FY23; more recent commentary states international sales reached 31.7% of revenue in Q2 FY26, suggesting the export share has since risen slightly.

pli_scheme.evidence: Government's PLI scheme for APIs/KSMs covers 215 approved applicants industry-wide; no company-specific confirmation that Alkem is a named PLI beneficiary was found in available sources.

china_plus_one.evidence: Analyst/third-party commentary: "Rising preference for Indian fluorochemical suppliers amid China+1 sentiment benefits NFIL's export-led business." CDMO segment (~25% of revenue) is over 95-96% export-driven with multi-year contracts and strong order-book visibility, consistent with supply-chain diversification tailwinds, though this framing came from analyst notes rather than a directly-read AR MD&A quote. 77% export / 23% domestic figure is reported for Q4FY25 specifically (not full-year FY25), treat as indicative rather than confirmed full-year AR figure.

inr_exposure.evidence: Company is heavily export-oriented (specialty chemicals to Europe/US/Southeast Asia, CDMO ~95%+ export) implying material USD exposure, but no explicit USD-revenue % or hedging policy was found in available sources.

china_plus_one.evidence: "Sona Comstar plans domestic magnet production to reduce China imports" — company announced local rare-earth magnet manufacturing in response to China restricting exports (China produces ~90% of global rare earth magnets); this is supply-chain de-risking (reducing reliance on Chinese inputs) rather than an explicit customer-side China+1 order-diversification narrative with quantified revenue attribution.

pli_scheme.evidence: "Sona BLW Precision Forgings received certification under the PLI scheme for the automobile and auto component industry" for its Traction Motor for electric three-wheelers, and subsequently secured certification for three additional EV products (two traction motors for e-3-wheelers, one for e-2-wheelers).

china_plus_one.evidence: Company management stated: 'We're now the second source for many products made in China, and the first choice for new ones.' Anthem sources less than 20% of its inputs from China, which it positions as a de-risked, China-alternative CRDMO supply chain amid the global China+1 shift (cited in IPO note/press coverage, not directly confirmed against the AR text itself).

pli_scheme.evidence: Anthem operates primarily as a CRDMO/specialty ingredients manufacturer rather than a bulk-drug producer; no confirmation found that it is an approved beneficiary under the PLI-for-Pharmaceuticals (bulk drugs/KSM/API) scheme.

govt_capex.evidence: Company serves marquee government/PSU clients (Coal India, ONGC, Indian Railways) and cited 'infrastructure project execution slower than expected' in FY25 commentary, with long-term infra-led growth anticipated; no explicit revenue % tied to govt capex disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: International markets accounted for 55% of total revenues in FY25, reflecting sustained demand in oil & gas, mining, and infrastructure; company exports to 50+ countries.

FY25 segmental revenue: Domestic ₹2,269 Cr (58%), International ₹1,128 Cr formulations + CDMO ₹446 Cr + API ₹76 Cr (~42% combined); Russia and branded-generics exports recorded double-digit growth, CDMO business grew 18%.

china_plus_one.evidence: Industry/press commentary notes global tier-1 suppliers 'increasingly utilized India as a primary manufacturing hub under the China Plus One strategy'; separately, Uno Minda is exploring domestic rare-earth magnet manufacturing with Mahindra amid China's export curbs (China controls ~90% of global rare-earth magnet supply). Management has also targeted mid-teens annual export growth FY26-28 via lighting/acoustics shipments to Europe and ASEAN. Sourcing is from press/analyst coverage rather than a confirmed direct AR quote attributing revenue growth to China+1.

pli_scheme.evidence: Uno Minda is named among approved 'Component Champion' beneficiaries under the Ministry of Heavy Industries' PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components, one of the auto-component makers set to begin availing PLI financial incentives from FY 2026-27; no revenue % disclosed yet as incentives had not started in FY25.
